products.shortDescription: Blue Mango F2 regular seeds — Somango XXL × Blueberry Butcher. Ten-seed pack from the DTF Genetics Blue Mango breeding project.
products.description:
Blue Mango F2 — Regular

Lineage: Somango XXL × Blueberry Butcher
Generation: F2
Seed type: Regular
Pack: 10 seeds

Blue Mango is a flagship DTF Genetics project selected around vigorous growth, strong branching, resin production, substantial flower structure, and a candy-blueberry-meets-ripe-mango aromatic direction.

Flowering observation: an 8–10 week flowering window has been used as a planning range for this project. Phenotype, environment, plant health, and cultivation method can change actual finish time.

Seeds from a segregating line can express meaningful plant-to-plant variation. Breeding observations describe the direction of the project; they are not guarantees of phenotype, yield, potency, aroma, flavor, or finish date.

Blue Mango F2 — Feminized

Lineage: Somango XXL × Blueberry Butcher
Generation: F2
Seed type: Feminized

This release belongs to the same Blue Mango breeding project documented in the DTF Genetics catalog. The project is selected around vigorous growth, branching, resin production, substantial flower structure, and a candy-blueberry-meets-ripe-mango aromatic direction.

Feminized describes the seed-production method and expected sex ratio; it does not guarantee identical plants. Individual phenotype, growth rate, aroma, flower structure, yield, potency, and finish time can vary with genetics and environment.

Blue Bubblegum F1 — Regular

Lineage: Bubblegum Kush × Blueberry Butcher
Generation: F1
Seed type: Regular

Blue Bubblegum is a DTF Genetics breeding project with a sweet fruit-and-bubblegum direction and is used as a parent in Mango Bubbles.

Naming note: the existing WooCommerce route currently uses “Blueberry bubblegum.” The route and product title are being preserved until that store-label difference is explicitly reconciled; the documented breeding-project name is Blue Bubblegum.

Breeding direction is not a guarantee that every seed will express the same phenotype, aroma, flavor, yield, potency, structure, or finish time.
